title: About this scroll
body: Made by @harisanthosh9. It grew out of the Day 1 to 6 series on the X For You code.
Each card cites a file and line range in xai-org/x-algorithm. Quoted code is short, and the attribution is in NOTICE (Apache License 2.0).
Built with Grok Bot. The plan is for a Grok Bot routine to watch the repo and draft new cards, with a human review before anything is published. That routine is not connected in this version.
This site does not post, like, follow, or DM on anyone's behalf, and it is not endorsed by X or xAI.
